privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.draftBody: This is a placeholder privacy policy. The final version, setting out exactly what personal data we collect, why, and for how long, has not yet been provided by the event organizer.
privacyPage.dataBody: Your name and your mobile number. The number is what signs you in, and what we send shift notifications to.
privacyPage.purposeBody: To schedule officials for an event, and to reach you about changes to your own shifts.
privacyPage.retentionBody: If you stop signing in, your account is anonymized automatically after 24 months. You get an SMS a month before that happens.
